(the `android-16.0.0_r1` tag).

[Pinned source](https://android.googlesource.com/platform/system/libufdt/+/7327a003b2588845698b0993c454719a1f7005dc/utils/src/mkdtboimg.py)

checks the tool's SHA-256 before using it.
